maddeler.e:
تسابقت (form VI)
# تَسَابَقْتُ (tasābaqtu) /ta.saː.baq.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَسَابَقَ (tasābaqa)
# تَسَابَقْتَ (tasābaqta) /ta.saː.baq.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَسَابَقَ (tasābaqa)
# تَسَابَقْتِ (tasābaqti) /ta.saː.baq.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَسَابَقَ (tasābaqa)
# تَسَابَقَتْ (tasābaqat) /ta.saː.ba.qat/: third-person fem
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
